{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Network.DNS
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as LBS
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe, listToMaybe)
import Control.Monad (when)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Numeric (showHex)

-- Internal DNS resolver service behind nginx reverse proxy
-- nginx config: proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8053;
--               proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr;
--               proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $request_id;

type ResolverCache = IORef [(ByteString, [ByteString])]

main :: IO ()
main = do
    cache <- newIORef []
    rs <- makeResolvSeed defaultResolvConf
    putStrLn "DNS resolver service starting on :8053"
    run 8053 (app rs cache)

app :: ResolvSeed -> ResolverCache -> Application
app rs cache req respond = do
    let path = rawPathInfo req
        method = requestMethod req
        headers = requestHeaders req
    case (method, path) of
        ("GET", "/resolve") -> handleResolve rs cache req respond
        ("POST", "/flush") -> handleFlush cache req respond
        ("POST", "/config") -> handleConfig rs cache req respond
        _ -> respond $ responseLBS status404 [] "Not found"

-- Origin validation for state-changing operations
-- We trust X-Forwarded-For from the reverse proxy to identify internal requests
validateOrigin :: Request -> Bool
validateOrigin req =
    let headers = requestHeaders req
        forwardedFor = lookup "X-Forwarded-For" headers
        origin = lookup "Origin" headers
        referer = lookup "Referer" headers
        -- Internal network prefix check
        isInternalIP ip = "10." `BS.isPrefixOf` ip ||
                          "192.168." `BS.isPrefixOf` ip ||
                          "127." `BS.isPrefixOf` ip
        -- Check if request comes from internal network via proxy
        fromInternal = case forwardedFor of
            Just ip -> isInternalIP (head $ C8.split ',' ip)
            Nothing -> False
        -- Origin/Referer check for CSRF protection
        originOk = case origin of
            Just o  -> "http://dns-admin.internal" `BS.isPrefixOf` o ||
                       "https://dns-admin.internal" `BS.isPrefixOf` o
            Nothing -> False  -- If no Origin header, reject the request
        refererOk = case referer of
            Just r  -> "http://dns-admin.internal" `BS.isPrefixOf` r ||
                       "https://dns-admin.internal" `BS.isPrefixOf` r
            Nothing -> False  -- If no Referer header, reject the request
    in fromInternal && (originOk || refererOk)

handleResolve :: ResolvSeed -> ResolverCache -> Application
handleResolve rs cache req respond = do
    let params = queryString req
        domain = fromMaybe "" $ join $ lookup "domain" params
    if BS.null domain
        then respond $ responseLBS status400 [] "Missing domain parameter"
        else do
            cached <- lookupCache cache domain
            case cached of
                Just results -> respond $ responseLBS status200
                    [("Content-Type", "application/json")]
                    (formatResults domain results)
                Nothing -> do
                    result <- withResolver rs $ \resolver ->
                        lookupA resolver (C8.unpack domain)
                    case result of
                        Left err -> respond $ responseLBS status500 []
                            (LBS.fromStrict $ C8.pack $ show err)
                        Right addrs -> do
                            let results = map (C8.pack . show) addrs
                            updateCache cache domain results
                            respond $ responseLBS status200
                                [("Content-Type", "application/json")]
                                (formatResults domain results)

handleFlush :: ResolverCache -> Application
handleFlush cache req respond =
    if validateOrigin req
        then do
            writeIORef cache []
            respond $ responseLBS status200 [] "Cache flushed"
        else respond $ responseLBS status403 [] "Forbidden"

handleConfig :: ResolvSeed -> ResolverCache -> Application
handleConfig rs cache req respond =
    if validateOrigin req
        then do
            body <- strictRequestBody req
            -- Apply upstream DNS configuration changes
            writeIORef cache []  -- flush on config change
            respond $ responseLBS status200 [] "Configuration updated"
        else respond $ responseLBS status403 [] "Forbidden"

lookupCache :: ResolverCache -> ByteString -> IO (Maybe [ByteString])
lookupCache cache domain = do
    entries <- readIORef cache
    return $ lookup domain entries

updateCache :: ResolverCache -> ByteString -> [ByteString] -> IO ()
updateCache cache domain results =
    modifyIORef cache (\entries -> (domain, results) : filter ((/= domain) . fst) entries)

-- Escape a ByteString so it is safe to embed inside a JSON string literal.
jsonEscape :: ByteString -> ByteString
jsonEscape = BS.concatMap escapeByte
  where
    escapeByte :: Word8 -> ByteString
    escapeByte w = case w of
        0x22 -> "\\\""          -- "
        0x5C -> "\\\\"          -- backslash
        0x08 -> "\\b"
        0x0C -> "\\f"
        0x0A -> "\\n"
        0x0D -> "\\r"
        0x09 -> "\\t"
        _ | w < 0x20 -> C8.pack ("\\u" ++ pad4 (showHex w ""))
          | otherwise -> BS.singleton w
    pad4 s = replicate (4 - length s) '0' ++ s

formatResults :: ByteString -> [ByteString] -> LBS.ByteString
formatResults domain results =
    LBS.fromStrict $ C8.intercalate "\n" $
        ["{ \"domain\": \"" <> jsonEscape domain <> "\","] ++
        ["  \"addresses\": [" <> C8.intercalate ", " (map (\r -> "\"" <> jsonEscape r <> "\"") results) <> "] }"]

join :: Maybe (Maybe a) -> Maybe a
join (Just x) = x
join Nothing = Nothing
